purpose: Define shared read-only display primitives for scalar values, text, badges/status, tables/lists and structured projections while preserving exact source/value provenance.

topics.name: Data Display Element
topics.purpose: Define shared read-only display primitives for scalar values, text, badges/status, tables/lists and structured projections while preserving exact source/value provenance.

semantics.source_rule: Displayed value resolves exact source/resource/field refs where machine-significant.
semantics.readonly_rule: Display element has no mutation semantics.
semantics.format_rule: Formatting/unit/localization is presentation and never changes canonical stored value.
semantics.status_rule: Color/icon/badge may visualize an explicit state but never invent state from appearance alone.
semantics.empty_rule: missing, null, unavailable, denied and empty are distinguishable when semantically relevant.
semantics.provenance_rule: Derived values may expose their derivation/source refs.
semantics.authority_rule: Displaying a value does not grant access to hidden source fields or mutators.

invariants.rule: Expose Elements are reusable human-interface primitives that project or invoke explicitly bound semantics; visual form, nesting, focus, color, position or enabled-looking state never creates ownership, authority or domain meaning.

hard_gates.condition: formatted value written back as canonical source implicitly
table row order creates semantic priority

references.purpose: Display primitives retain explicit element/resource identities.
